mechanics.claim: Crash Down deals damage and applies CC once on landing, then continues sliding to hit further enemies along the path.
mechanics.quote: Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.8}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She will continue {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward another 320 units

mechanics.claim: Q is disabled while Rell is dashing during Crash Down's cast, but E and R are usable.
Mount Up's empowered attack resets Rell's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Ferromancy: Mount Up {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rell's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack's damage is on-hit damage applied on arrival/collision of the charge, separate from the base attack damage.
mechanics.quote: Upon arrival or collision of the charge, her basic attack deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or leaves sight/range during the empowered attack's cast time, the attack is cancelled but the effect is not consumed (can be reused).
mechanics.quote: If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.

mechanics.claim: The shield lasts until destroyed or until Mount Up is cast, not for a fixed duration.
mechanics.quote: granting herself a {{tip|shield}} that lasts until destroyed or casting

mechanics.claim: Rell always starts the game mounted and reverts to mounted after recall or respawn.
mechanics.quote: Upon completing a {{si|Recall}} channel or respawning, '''Rell''' will automatically revert to {{sbc|Mounted}} form
